description.default: GitHub tools with built-in result cards for repositories, issues, commits, pull requests, files, code search, releases, Actions, GraphQL, comments, reviews and remote writes.
description.en: GitHub tools with built-in result cards for repositories, issues, commits, pull requests, files, code search, releases, Actions, GraphQL, comments, reviews and remote writes.
description.zh-CN: GitHub 工具，自带结果卡片：查询仓库、议题、提交、PR、文件、代码与 Actions，执行 GraphQL，并支持评论、审查、Revert PR、Release 资产和远端写操作。
description.zh-TW: GitHub 工具，自帶結果卡片：查詢儲存庫、議題、提交、PR、檔案、程式碼與 Actions，執行 GraphQL，並支援評論、審查、Revert PR、Release 資產和遠端寫操作。
